eli (ml-eng): onboarding Ivy locale-sensitive invoice LoRA. quickpack shows thousands separator (\u00A0 thin-space) getting stripped in fr/de cases.
priya (applied-ml): are these from prod shadow or synthetic locale pack?
eli (ml-eng): synthetic fr_de_pack + 2k shadow requests. command used:
```
python eval_pack.py --model redwood-4x-lora-sparse75-int3 --dataset ivy_invoice_locale_quick.json --metrics format_accuracy,amount_f1
```
snip results:
```
{"format_accuracy":"0.792","amount_f1":"0.953"}
```
tom (qa): failing examples show "1\u00A0234,00 \u20AC" -> "1234,00\u20AC" (thin-space removed) and sometimes trailing zeros dropped.
shadowbot: shadow-roll summary: requests=8k, 5xx=0, format_mismatch_rate=0.21 vs baseline 0.02
priya (applied-ml): big regression. Suggested mitigation: 1) graft only on FF layers, 2) reduce sparsity 75->50, 3) quantize with per-channel symmetric scales, 4) add postprocess preserve_thousands_sep.
eli (ml-eng): plan: build redwood-4x-lora-sparse50-ff-only-int3 with per-channel symmetric quant and run 1k quickpack + 1% shadow. uploading artifact after build.
deploy-bot: canary scheduled env=staging->prod-shadow percent=1 start=2026-03-23T09:15:00Z rollback_on=format_accuracy<0.95 or format_mismatch_rate>0.03
tom (qa): I'll add exact-match checks for localized separators and a regex to enforce two decimals. Will block if any fail.
priya (applied-ml): also run ablation: graft to FF-only vs FF+LN and compare format_accuracy delta. add to PR description.
eli (ml-eng): uploaded s3://redwood-artifacts/ivy/redwood-4x-lora-sparse50-ff-only-int3.tar.gz sha256=9f4c2d... re-running eval now.
new results:
```
{"format_accuracy":"0.962","amount_f1":"0.968"}
```
priya (applied-ml): much better. set up 24h shadow monitor for format_mismatch_rate, amount_f1, p99 latency. @tom will watch alerts.
eli (ml-eng): follow-ups: run larger locale packs (es, ru), check KV-cache offsets with 4k prompts, and open a short ablation doc on LN graft effects. :white_check_mark:
